page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question
Excretory Products and their Elimination · 2 marks

steps.label: What is filtered
steps.why: Blood pressure in the glomerulus does the pushing, so the filtrate is squeezed out through the sieve of the capsule.
common_mistakes: Writing that urine is formed here. Only the filtrate is.
Naming the wrong direction. Blood goes from glomerulus into the capsule.
steps.memory_tip: First step of urine making: blood is pushed through a sieve.
steps.margin_note: Say it is the FIRST step. That word is often marked.
lines: The first step in the formation of urine is
the filtration of blood from the glomerulus
into the lumen of Bowman's capsule.

steps.label: It uses no energy
steps.why: The heart has already supplied the pressure, so the kidney spends nothing of its own at this step.
common_mistakes: Calling it active transport. It consumes no energy.
steps.memory_tip: Blood pressure does the work, not the kidney.
steps.margin_note: One line, but it is a whole mark.

lines.text: This needs no energy: it is glomerular filtration

insider_note: The second mark is for 'non-energy consuming'. Most answers describe the filtering and stop.
